_comment: Intentional current deltas against the frozen v0.4 connectivity baseline. Historical wave-6 rationale is retained below; current renewal decisions supersede intermediate voltage labels and regulator topology. The baseline is not rewritten. check_baseline.py checks every declared delta still holds.

_historical_sources.+12V rail / +5V rail / -12V rail: baseline unresolved rows 1-3; PTC second pins + TVS rail legs + Faston tabs + J10/J11 pin pairs derived from spec-architecture-review.md Board B section, board-b-synth-power.md Output Connectors tables (J6=-12V, J7=+12V, J8=+5V, J9=GND both tabs), and the component-dealon-dw254p-2x8-l0-c4749189 pin map (pin-pair rail map: 1-2 -12V, 3-8 GND, 9-10 +12V, 11-12 +5V, 13-14 CV, 15-16 GATE; updated per dec-renewal-eurorack-sockets). TVS1/TVS2 cathode-to-rail, anode-to-GND per SMAJ15A/SMAJ6.5A symbol pin maps; TVS3 cathode-to-GND anode-to--12V per decisions.json dec-tvs3-orientation-lock (BB-9).
_historical_sources.GATE rail / CV rail: baseline unresolved rows 4-5; isolated J10/J11 stubs per board-b-synth-power.md J10/J11 table and the header bundle pin map.
_historical_sources.GND added pins (J9/J10/J11): baseline unresolved row 6; J9 both tabs per the Faston table, J10/J11 pins 3-8 GND moat per the header bundle pin map.
_historical_sources.GND added pins (D1.2, D2.2): review finding BB-11: buck catch-diode anode ground returns, omitted from the doc net tables and the baseline's own unresolved list.
_historical_sources.GND added pins (C3.2, C4.2, C11.1, R5.2,: baseline unresolved row 7 (doc-implied DC-DC GND pins: output-cap far plates, U4 bottom FB resistor, C33 feedforward mirror).
_historical_sources.C12 pins (-13.5V OUT: C12.2, GND: C12.1): decisions.json neg-rail-cap-bank: third can added to the -13.5V output bank so no output electrolytic exceeds 85% of its 150kHz-derated ripple rating at the 0.8 A rated load. C12 is not in the netlist-derived baseline because it did not exist at v0.4.0. Pin sense mirrors C24 (pin 2 on the rail, pin 1 on GND).
_historical_sources.GND added pins (LED2.2, LED3.1, LED4.2): review finding BB-13: LED indicator wiring absent from the baseline; polarity per the component-project-passives pin maps (KT-0603YG green pin1=A/pin2=K reversed numbering; KT-0603B and KT-0603R pin1=K/pin2=A). LED4 anode on GND so the red indicator conducts into the negative rail.
_historical_sources.J5 pins (+15V gen: J5.1/J5.2, GND: J5.5/: locked A-B interface contract (board-split-decision.md #90 decision set (b), mirrored in board-b-synth-power.md): pins 1-2 +15V, 3 ATT, 4 PDOK, 5-6 GND. ATT/PDOK are open-drain with no on-board pull-up.
decisions.json dec-p1-att-pdok-provision: PogoPad_1x04 bare pads, pin 4 declared NO_CONNECT.
_historical_sources.TP3.1 / TP4.1 / TP5.1: bare-copper rail test pads carried from the legacy dc-dc-conversion sheet (TP3 +13.5V, TP4 +7.5V, TP5 -13.5V); pre-declared as board-b exclusions in the component-spec-audit inventory.

_sources.renewal socket pin pairs: dec-renewal-eurorack-sockets: J10/J11 exact DEALON keyed header requires conventional pin1/red stripe -12V, pins3-8 GND,9-10 +12V,11-12 +5V,13-14 CV,15-16 GATE. This intentionally replaces the legacy numeric map.
_sources.renamed input and intermediate nets: dec-renewal-ldos and current AP63201 component owner: +15V INPUT feeds AP63201 +13.44V PRE, LM2596 +6.519V PRE, and inverting LM2596 -14.145V PRE. Numeric labels follow nominal setpoints, not measured voltages.
_sources.U2 switcher topology: AP63201 replaces nonsynchronous LM2596 U2: remove D1/C31, use FB pin1, EN pin2 tied to VIN, VIN pin3, GND pin4, SW pin5, BST pin6 with C38 to SW. C3/C14/C20/C36/C37 form the ceramic output bank; C39/C46 are ceramic input bypass.
_sources.regulator pins and new feedback: dec-renewal-ldos: U6/U7 LT1963A pins1/2 input,3/6 ground,4 output,5 ADJ; R20/R21/R22 and R23/R24/R25 are explicit series-top dividers. U8 LT3015 pins1/3/6 negative input,2 ground,4/5 output. Imported U8 pin functions were corrected to the manufacturer Q-package drawing.
_sources.independent LDO output capacitors: C40/C41/C42 are exact Panasonic 25SVPF47M polymer capacitors. Negative output C42 uses pin1 positive to GND and pin2 negative to U8 OUT. Existing bulk banks remain.
_sources.preserved earlier derived connectivity: The historical source notes below retain rail output, TVS/PTC, LED, J5/P1 and testpad derivations. Their old intermediate names and replaced parts describe the earlier design only.
_sources.two-pole output replacement: dec-renewal-screw-terminals: J6.1GND/J6.2−12V,J7.1+5V/J7.2+12V; separate contacts, old J8/J9 removed.
